events.title: Traveloot is participating in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Traveloot is currently participating in Steam Next Fest. You can try out Traveloot demo.We really appreciate all your support! Adding the game to your wishlist and following it on Steam helps a lot :)Thanks!

events.title: Traveloot 0.10 - Localization
events.summary: More languages have been added to the game with this update! If you notice any issues with the translations, please let me know.This update also includes a bunch of small changes and bug fixes based on your feedback. For example, the resource icon now appears on each upgrade node.

events.title: Traveloot 0.09 - Player Feedback
events.summary: These are changes based on player feedback. I’ll also look into adding a new statistics page. It might be a bit difficult to do since it depends a lot on which characters are in the team.- Fixed some bugs and text issues.- Changed the cursor visuals. It will also grow as you upgrade the magnet.- Elites are now more visible.- Hovering over the resource box will show which nodes require that resource.- Added a light effect when finishing a stage.

events.title: Traveloot - Pacing
events.summary: Here's a new small update to Traveloot.- Carpenter will hit enemies more often.- Changed the pacing. In the first few levels, there’s less need to grind previous levels.

events.title: Traveloot 0.06 - French version
events.summary: The main changes were focused on localization and supporting multiple languages.Continued work on the main gameChanged the healing SFXIncreased magnet strengthAdded a bit of water to the pond levelFixed various bugsAdded the first additional language: FrenchContinued work on localization and multi-language support

events.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Some players might be wondering if Traveloot supports the Steam Deck, and the answer is yes!Controls & NavigationTraveloot was built with full controller support in mind. Controls cannot be rebound in-game, but the control scheme is simple and doesn't require many buttons.PerformanceThe game is capped at 60 FPS and runs smoothly on Steam Deck, even at a 5W TDP limit.SupportIf you encounter any issues, have questions, or would like to share feedback and suggestions, please post in the Steam Discu
